tasks.short: Prepare the agreement, closing statement and identity file.

steps.what: Collect party, price and property fields from the file.
Fill the purchase agreement and the closing statement.
Complete the identity questionnaire and set the risk rating.
Review lease options and any clause the template does not hold.
Send the reviewed pack for signature.
Draw the deed from the signed agreement.

tasks.design: The {CRM} fills a purchase agreement and a closing statement from party and price fields. The agent sets the identity risk rating and rewrites any lease clause the template does not hold. Signature goes out only for that reviewed version. The notary still draws the deed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Agreements were retyped from mail into a document, and the deed was mixed into the same chore.
tasks.enabler_now: A template can fill the standard pages from fields that are already on the file. The deed and odd clauses cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding which special condition is safe to leave in, and rating the client.
tasks.human_edge: The agent knows which clause this buyer actually needs.

ambition.what: The agent decides the same day whether a standard agreement is complete enough to send for signature.

tasks.altitude: Less retyping. The agent still owns clause exceptions and the risk rating, and does not draft deeds.

reach.task: Approve a nonstandard clause the template cannot hold
reach.learn: Which clauses the broker must see before signature

evidence.claim: A brokerage system builds a purchase agreement from CRM data and sends it for signature.
The same system records an identity questionnaire and leaves the risk rating with the agent.
Dutch makelaars must identify clients under the Wwft.

assumptions: Focal role is the sales agent. The notary's deed is supplier time and is not saved.
Boundary: from a complete party pack to a signature request. Negotiation of the price is a different task.

Fields: legal names, property id, price, completion date, inclusions, financing deadline. Producer is the agent from the listing and the bid. Fallback: type a missing field. Lease options and deeds are not forced into the purchase template.
Configure the {CRM} template and {ESIGN} before custom code.
Upkeep of 7 hours covers template clauses and identity questions when the standard form changes.
Wwft is the Dutch rule named in the digest. Who may draft a deed is a national rule.
unknowns: Whether the {CRM} template already matches the local standard agreement.
Whether leases are a real share of this desk or a rare extra.
research_questions: What share of packs are standard purchase agreements rather than leases or mixed files?
Who sets the risk rating today, the agent or a compliance colleague?

incremental.description: Update agreement clauses and identity questions when the standard form changes

approvals.approved_version: risk rating recorded on this client file
agreement pack version the agent reviewed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: half the packs are leases or one-off clauses, so the template barely fires and the notary's work is untouched. High: most packs are standard purchase agreements and only the clause read and the rating remain. Deed time is excluded either way.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Set a competitive asking price from recent comparable sales.

steps.what: Pull recent sales of the same type into a table.
Drop sales that are not real rivals and adjust the price.
Write the asking-price note with each figure sourced.

loop.input: Adjusted price and the kept comparable rows
loop.check: Each figure must point at a row the agent kept
loop.stop: One draft; an unsourced figure is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The price is a judgement on this home, not a sentence template

tasks.design: A {BI} table lists recent sales. The agent throws out the ones that are not rivals and sets the asking price. The note cites only the rows the agent kept, and it is not a loan valuation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comparables were copied by hand, and a model figure was easy to treat as the price.
tasks.enabler_now: A maintained sales table can be filtered. The adjustment for condition and street still needs the agent.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing which difference a buyer on this street will pay for.
tasks.human_edge: The agent has walked the home and knows what the table cannot see.
tasks.altitude: The price decision stays. The agent stops rebuilding the sales list and will not sign a figure that has no comparable.

reach.task: Review an asking price that sits far from the model value
reach.learn: When the broker expects to be shown the gap

evidence.claim: An automated valuation is tested monthly against sale prices and is not for mortgage lending.
A large buyer quit home buying after a write-down it blamed on price forecasts.
A house valuation is not credit scoring under the cited AI Act point.

assumptions: Focal role is the sales agent setting an asking price. Boundary: from recent sales to a sourced price note. Advising the client in a meeting is a separate task.
Fields: address, type, size, sale date, sale price, and model value. Producer is the sales record. Fallback: the agent adds a sale the extract missed and says so on the note.
Use the {BI} dataset before building a model. Feed cost is why run cost is medium. Feed runtime is not agent time.
Upkeep of 5 hours covers area rules and which columns the note may cite.
The model value is a column, not the asking price and not a loan figure.
unknowns: Whether a sales feed already covers this town.
How often the agent's price differs from the model value by more than a small gap.
research_questions: Which adjustments does the agent apply most often: condition, floor, or outside space?

incremental.description: Maintain area filters and the columns the price note is allowed to cite

approvals.approved_version: price note for the comparable set the agent kept

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the feed misses local sales, so the agent rebuilds the table and the adjustment takes as long as today. High: the table is usable and only the write-up shrinks. The cited forecast failure is why the model value never becomes the price.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Arrange the homes and times to show a buyer.

steps.what: Propose visit slots from the buyer's and the owner's calendars.
Choose the homes and the order for this buyer.
Agree the tour with the buyer by phone.
Confirm the owner will allow the visit.
Send the invites for the accepted tour.
Call again when someone misses a slot.

tasks.design: {CALENDAR} proposes slots. The agent picks the homes and the order, then agrees the tour by phone with the buyer and checks the owner. Invites go out only for that accepted plan. A missed slot is still a phone call.
tasks.previous_blocker: Tours were arranged in mail and by calling down a paper list.
tasks.enabler_now: Calendars can propose free slots. Choosing which home is worth the trip, and getting a yes, stays a conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Knowing the buyer will refuse a home that matches the form.
tasks.human_edge: The agent has heard what the buyer will not walk into.

ambition.what: The agent decides which three homes are worth a trip before any invite goes out.

tasks.altitude: Fewer empty slots. The agent still decides the route and still makes the calls.

reach.task: Build a day plan around fixed appointment windows
reach.learn: How a fixed window changes which home can be second on the tour

evidence.claim: Buyer matching on hard criteria is a filter, not a model. Scheduling still needs a person to agree the visit.
Mail to prospective buyers needs a lawful basis.

assumptions: Focal role is the sales agent. The owner's confirmation is customer time.
Boundary: from a wish profile to invites for one tour. The visit itself is a different task.
Fields: listing id, slot start, slot end, buyer id, owner permission. Producer of free time is the calendar. Fallback: the agent types a slot that was agreed only by phone.
Configure {CALENDAR} against the {CRM} listing before custom code.
Upkeep of 2 hours covers the invite text. This design does not record calls, so the works-council recording rule is not triggered.
unknowns: Whether owners keep availability anywhere but the phone.
How many homes a typical tour contains.
research_questions: What share of agreed slots are cancelled the same day?

incremental.description: Keep invite wording and the maximum homes on a tour up to date

approvals.approved_version: tour plan the buyer accepted and the agent chose

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: owners have no calendar, so proposals fail and every slot is a call. High: both sides keep calendars and only the choice of homes and the confirmation call remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: List homes that fit the buyer's needs and stated budget.

steps.what: Turn the wish profile into budget, area and size filters.
Generate the property list inside the buyers stated budget.
Cut homes that match the numbers but not the buyer's situation.
Write a cover note and send the shortlist.

loop.input: The shortlist the agent kept and the wish profile
loop.output: Cover note naming why each home is on the list
loop.check: Every home in the note must be on the kept shortlist
loop.stop: One draft; a home that was cut is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The reason is the buyer's situation, not the filter alone

steps.what: Retype the same list into a separate mail by hand.

tasks.design: The agent sets hard filters on the {CRM}: area, size, and the budget the buyer stated. The filter returns a raw list. The agent cuts homes that do not fit the situation, then sends that shortlist. Hand retyping the same list stops. There is no credit score.
tasks.previous_blocker: Shortlists were rebuilt in mail because the wish profile was not fields.
tasks.enabler_now: A filter on stored listings can replace the retyping. Fit to the person cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Knowing a home that matches the form is still wrong for this buyer.
tasks.human_edge: The agent heard the constraint that never made it into a field.

ambition.what: Buyers who today get a list only after a second chase receive a checked shortlist the same day the filters are set.

tasks.altitude: The agent spends the list time on cuts, not on retyping. Sending still waits for the cut.

reach.task: Decide which listing fields every search may use
reach.learn: Which fields the broker treats as hard filters

evidence.claim: A Dutch brokerage search matches listings to a buyer's hard and soft wishes and can send new matches.
Matching on hard criteria is a filter. Financial fit here uses the stated budget, not a credit decision.
A prospect list needs a lawful basis before it is mailed.

assumptions: Focal role is the sales agent. Boundary: from a wish profile to one sent shortlist. The interview that creates the profile is a different task.

Fields: area, minimum size, property type, and maximum price the buyer stated. Producer is the agent from the profile. Fallback: leave a filter blank rather than guess. Do not import bank or credit data.
Configure the {CRM} search before a ranking model. The digest treats matching as a filter.
Upkeep of 4 hours covers filter definitions. Soft wishes stay in the cut step, not in a score.
Eliminate only the retyping. The cover mail still needs the agent's shortlist version.
unknowns: Whether listings from other agencies are in this {CRM}.
Whether buyers already have a recorded budget.
research_questions: What share of filter hits does the agent cut before sending?

incremental.description: Adjust hard filters when listing fields change

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: wish profiles are prose, so filters are thin and the agent still builds the list. High: filters are complete and retyping is gone, but the cut and the note remain. No credit decision is automated.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Agreement retyping and list retyping shrink. Asking prices, tour choices and shortlist cuts stay with the agent, who can hold a pack or a list that is not the reviewed version.
reach: Real estate brokers: see nonstandard clauses and large price gaps
Travel agents: plan a day around fixed visit windows
skills_to_grow: Setting hard search filters without a credit field
Separating a deed from the purchase agreement
role.ambitious_version: A standard agreement goes for signature the day the fields and the rating are checked, and a buyer gets a cut shortlist without a second chase.
